intro: Viewer Lobby is a local multi-platform play queue. Follow the sections in order: choose who can join, review the chat commands, decide what the public overlay may show, then import the creator controls.

sections.title: 1. Lobby basics
sections.description: Choose who can join and what happens when the stream ends.
sections.notice: Recommended first test: enable Twitch only, keep the queue at 30, and choose Close so test entries are not erased automatically.

sections.title: 2. Viewer chat commands
sections.description: These commands already use the main platform chat intakes.
sections.notice: Do not recreate these commands in Command Sync. Viewers type them directly in Twitch, YouTube, Kick, or TikTok chat.

sections.title: 3. Optional gamertags
sections.description: Keep private player names off the public overlay unless you need them.

sections.title: 4. Ignored accounts
sections.description: Service bots on this list cannot join or run lobby commands.

sections.title: 5. OBS overlay appearance
sections.description: Control only what viewers see in the read-only browser source.
sections.notice: Add the source at its intended browser resolution and crop it. Stretching a browser source makes text blurry.
